live.method: Real keyboard input for append; PM commands for other edits; stock worker commit response measures local durability. Exact last generated operation counter observed in outbox plus zero pending gates whole-edit durable ACK; index-count polling has a 5ms interval.

method.sharedSubset: one paragraph, ASCII text, bold and italic
method.transport: same loopback HTTP append/catch-up; 50ms polling; one transaction per user edit; commit before ACK
method.durability: IndexedDB local log and retry outbox; PostgreSQL synchronous_commit=on; retained update log; no compaction in paired comparison
method.render: append: actual keyboard beforeinput to second requestAnimationFrame; other edits: PM command dispatch to second rAF; presentation opportunity, not physical paint
method.memory: post-GC page + dedicated worker V8 used heap and backing storage; excludes browser native/DOM/GPU allocations
method.order: engine order alternates between cells and rounds; one unreported warmup round; fresh browser contexts per cell
method.caveat: Paired results compare production Concord bridge/WASM with official Yjs binding in a common harness. Actual Concord gateway measurements are separate.
